founding.sentence: Three of us left a bank’s platform team in 2017 to build software that _its owners could still run after we left._
founding.signedBy: **Ruth Okafor, Mats de Vries and Leila Haddad**, founders

entries.title: Three engineers, one port
entries.body: The first client moved containers through Rotterdam on a scheduler nobody could restart. We rebuilt it in five months.
entries.evidence: Handover doc, 14 Jun 2017. Their team has run it alone since.

entries.title: Our first fixed-scope contract
entries.body: We stopped billing by the hour for new builds. Scope and price fit on one page, and we carry the overrun.
entries.evidence: Overrun cost us 6% of revenue in 2019, 0.6% in 2025.

entries.title: Two offices, one way of working
entries.body: Lisbon opened the week everything closed. We wrote down how we work so nobody had to be in the room.

entries.title: We stopped renting out engineers
entries.body: Staff augmentation was 30% of revenue. It also meant our people sat in other teams with no say in the outcome.
entries.evidence: Revenue fell 18% that year and recovered in 2024.

entries.title: Open-sourced our deploy tooling
entries.body: Clients kept asking to keep the scripts we used. Now they can, along with anyone else.

entries.title: Forty people
entries.body: Thirty-one write production code every week, including all three founders. Nobody only manages.

practices.rule: Scope and price fit on one page
practices.detail: If we cannot describe the work in one page, we are not ready to price it. Overruns are ours to absorb.

practices.rule: The people who sell it build it
practices.detail: No handoff from a sales team. The engineer on your first call is on your project.
practices.check: Ask who will write the code

practices.rule: A demo every Friday, never slides
practices.detail: Working software in a shared environment, every week, from week one.

practices.rule: We write the runbook, then leave
practices.detail: Every handover includes a runbook your own team has used to restore the system once.
